#### Extract spe_chemo data with Biopsyphase having 3 columns

```{r}

# Extract the colData from the SpatialExperiment object
col_data <- colData(spe_chemo)

# Check unique values in BiopsyPhase to confirm
unique_biopsy_phases <- unique(col_data$BiopsyPhase)
print(unique_biopsy_phases)

# Convert colData to a data.frame
col_data_df <- as.data.frame(col_data)

# Now you can use dplyr functions on col_data_df
patients_with_all_phases <- col_data_df %>%
  group_by(PatientID) %>%
  filter(all(c("On-treatment", "Baseline", "Post-treatment") %in% BiopsyPhase)) %>%
  summarize() %>%
  pull(PatientID)

# Filter the original data for these PatientIDs
filtered_indices <- which(col_data$PatientID %in% patients_with_all_phases)

# Extract the relevant data
if (length(filtered_indices) > 0) {
    filtered_spe_chemo <- spe_chemo[, filtered_indices]
} else {
    stop("No entries found for patients with all BiopsyPhase values.")
}

# Print out the structure of the filtered SpatialExperiment
print(filtered_spe_chemo)
```

#### Find all the highest expressed biomarkers in each cell typeGetting the data for patient with ID NT009 to get parameters for the model using the chemotherapy only dataset.

```{r}

spe_chemotherapy_patient_1 <- spe_chemo[, colData(spe_chemo)$PatientID == "NT009"]

spe_chemotherapy_patient_1
```

```{r}

# Generate the plot using the color column in colData
dittoDimPlot(
  spe_chemotherapy_patient_1, 
  var = "ParentCell", 
  reduction.use = "UMAP_mnnCorrected", 
  size = 0.2,
  do.label = TRUE,
  labels.size = 2.5,
  do.raster = TRUE,
  legend.show = TRUE
) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +

```

```{r}

# Function to count cells by type and biopsyphase
count_cells_by_type_and_phase <- function(spe) {
  # Extract cell type and biopsyphase information from colData
  cell_data <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))
  
  # Ensure 'ParentCell' and 'BiopsyPhase' columns exist
  if (!all(c("ParentCell", "BiopsyPhase") %in% colnames(cell_data))) {
    stop("Both 'ParentCell' and 'BiopsyPhase' columns must be present in colData")
  }
  
  # Count cells
  cell_counts <- cell_data %>%
    group_by(ParentCell, BiopsyPhase) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = BiopsyPhase, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Calculate total for each cell type
  cell_counts$Total <- rowSums(cell_counts[, -1])
  
  # Reorder columns to have Total as the second column
  cell_counts <- cell_counts %>%
    select(ParentCell, Total, everything())
  
  return(cell_counts)
}

```

```{r}

# Main analysis script
main_analysis <- function(spe) {
  # Perform cell count analysis
  result <- count_cells_by_type_and_phase(spe)
  
  # Print the result
  print(result)
  
  # Optionally, you can save the result to a CSV file
  # write.csv(result, "cell_count_analysis_result.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(result)
  
}
```

```{r}

result <- main_analysis(spe_chemotherapy_patient_1)
result <- result %>% filter(ParentCell != "Other")
result
```

```{r}

# Function to calculate column-wise statistics
calculate_column_stats <- function(data, column) {
  total_cells <- sum(data[[column]])
  ratios <- data[[column]] / total_cells
  variance <- var(data[[column]])
  
  tibble(
    ParentCell = data$ParentCell,
    Column = column,
    Count = data[[column]],
    Total_in_Column = total_cells,
    Ratio = round(ratios, 4),
    Proportion_Percent = round(ratios * 100, 2),
    Column_Variance = round(variance, 2)
  )
}

```

```{r}

# Calculate statistics for each column
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(result, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- result %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}

print(ratio_analysis)
```

#### Getting the mean expression values of some of the protein biomarkers in the various cell types for spe_chemotherapy Patient 1.

```{r}

extract_mean_expression_tidy <- function(spe, 
                                         cell_type_column = "ParentCell", 
                                         assay_name = "transformed_counts") {
  # Check if the cell type column exists in colData
  if (!cell_type_column %in% colnames(colData(spe))) {
    stop(paste("Column", cell_type_column, "not found in colData"))
  }
  
  # Check if the specified assay exists
  if (!assay_name %in% assayNames(spe)) {
    stop(paste("Assay", assay_name, "not found in the SpatialExperiment object"))
  }
  
  # Extract expression data
  expression_data <- assay(spe, assay_name)
  
  # Extract cell type information
  cell_types <- colData(spe)$ParentCell
  
  # Calculate mean expression for each biomarker and cell type
  mean_expression <- t(apply(expression_data, 1, function(x) tapply(x, cell_types, median, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  # Convert to a tidy data frame
  mean_expression_df <- as.data.frame(mean_expression) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Biomarker") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Biomarker, names_to = "CellType", values_to = "MeanExpression")
  
  # Sort the data frame by CellType
  mean_expression_df_sorted <- mean_expression_df %>%
    arrange(CellType, Biomarker)
  
  return(mean_expression_df_sorted)
}
```

```{r}

results2 <- extract_mean_expression_tidy(spe_chemotherapy_patient_1, cell_type_column = "ParentCell",assay_name = "transformed_counts")

results2 
```

```{r}
# Function to count cells by type and biopsyphase
count_cells_by_type_and_phase <- function(spe) {
  # Extract cell type and biopsyphase information from colData
  cell_data <- as.data.frame(colData(spe))
  
  # Ensure 'ParentCell' and 'BiopsyPhase' columns exist
  if (!all(c("ParentCell", "BiopsyPhase") %in% colnames(cell_data))) {
    stop("Both 'ParentCell' and 'BiopsyPhase' columns must be present in colData")
  }
  
  # Count cells
  cell_counts <- cell_data %>%
    group_by(ParentCell, BiopsyPhase) %>%
    summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = BiopsyPhase, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)
  
  # Calculate total for each cell type
  cell_counts$Total <- rowSums(cell_counts[, -1])
  
  # Reorder columns to have Total as the second column
  cell_counts <- cell_counts %>%
    select(ParentCell, Total, everything())
  
  return(cell_counts)
}

```

```{r}

# Main analysis script
main_analysis <- function(spe) {
  # Perform cell count analysis
  result <- count_cells_by_type_and_phase(spe)
  
  # Print the result
  print(result)
  
  # Optionally, you can save the result to a CSV file
  # write.csv(result, "cell_count_analysis_result.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  
  return(result)
  
}
```

```{r}

# Function to calculate column-wise statistics
calculate_column_stats <- function(data, column) {
  total_cells <- sum(data[[column]])
  ratios <- data[[column]] / total_cells
  variance <- var(data[[column]])
  
  tibble(
    ParentCell = data$ParentCell,
    Column = column,
    Count = data[[column]],
    Total_in_Column = total_cells,
    Ratio = round(ratios, 4),
    Proportion_Percent = round(ratios * 100, 2),
    Column_Variance = round(variance, 2)
  )
}

```

#### Getting the mean expression values of some of the protein biomarkers in the various cell types for spe_chemo_immunotherapy Patient 1.

```{r}

extract_mean_expression_tidy <- function(spe, 
                                         cell_type_column = "ParentCell", 
                                         assay_name = "transformed_counts") {
  # Check if the cell type column exists in colData
  if (!cell_type_column %in% colnames(colData(spe))) {
    stop(paste("Column", cell_type_column, "not found in colData"))
  }
  
  # Check if the specified assay exists
  if (!assay_name %in% assayNames(spe)) {
    stop(paste("Assay", assay_name, "not found in the SpatialExperiment object"))
  }
  
  # Extract expression data
  expression_data <- assay(spe, assay_name)
  
  # Extract cell type information
  cell_types <- colData(spe)$ParentCell
  
  # Calculate mean expression for each biomarker and cell type
  mean_expression <- t(apply(expression_data, 1, function(x) tapply(x, cell_types, median, na.rm = TRUE)))
  
  # Convert to a tidy data frame
  mean_expression_df <- as.data.frame(mean_expression) %>%
    rownames_to_column("Biomarker") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Biomarker, names_to = "CellType", values_to = "MeanExpression")
  
  # Sort the data frame by CellType
  mean_expression_df_sorted <- mean_expression_df %>%
    arrange(CellType, Biomarker)
  
  return(mean_expression_df_sorted)
}
```


```{r}

# Generate the plot using the color column in colData
dittoDimPlot(
  spe_chemo_immu_patient_4, 
  var = "ParentCell", 
  reduction.use = "UMAP_mnnCorrected", 
  size = 0.2,
  do.label = TRUE,
  labels.size = 2.5,
  do.raster = TRUE,
  legend.show = TRUE
) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Patient NT017 Cell types on UMAP for spe_chemo_immunotherapy")
```

```{r}

chemo_immuno_result4 <- main_analysis(spe_chemo_immu_patient_4)
chemo_immuno_result4 <- chemo_immuno_result4 %>% filter(ParentCell != "Other")
chemo_immuno_result4
```

```{r}

# Calculate statistics for each column
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(chemo_immuno_result4, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- chemo_immuno_result4 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}

print(ratio_analysis)
```

```{r}
# Calculate statistics for each column
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(chemo_immuno_result22, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- chemo_immuno_result22 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(chemo_immuno_result29, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- chemo_immuno_result29 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}
print(ratio_analysis)
```

```{r}
) +
```


```{r}

chemo_immuno_result61 <- main_analysis(spe_chemo_immu_patient_61)
chemo_immuno_result61 <- chemo_immuno_result61 %>% filter(ParentCell != "Other")
chemo_immuno_result61
```

```{r}

# Calculate statistics for each column
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(chemo_immuno_result61, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- chemo_immuno_result61 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}

print(ratio_analysis)
```


```{r}

# Generate the plot using the color column in colData
dittoDimPlot(
  spe_chemo_immu_patient_68, 
  var = "ParentCell", 
  reduction.use = "UMAP_mnnCorrected", 
  size = 0.2,
  do.label = TRUE,
  labels.size = 2.5,
  do.raster = TRUE,
  legend.show = TRUE
) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank()) +
  ggtitle("Patient NT257 Cell types on UMAP for spe_chemo_immunotherapy")
```

```{r}

chemo_immuno_result68 <- main_analysis(spe_chemo_immu_patient_68)
chemo_immuno_result68 <- chemo_immuno_result68 %>% filter(ParentCell != "Other")
chemo_immuno_result68
```

```{r}

# Calculate statistics for each column
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(chemo_immuno_result68, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- chemo_immuno_result68 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}

print(ratio_analysis)
```

```{r}
  ggtitle("Patient NT279 Cell types on UMAP for spe_chemo_immunotherapy")
```

```{r}

chemo_immuno_result75 <- main_analysis(spe_chemo_immu_patient_75)
chemo_immuno_result75 <- chemo_immuno_result75 %>% filter(ParentCell != "Other")
chemo_immuno_result75
```

```{r}

# Calculate statistics for each column
columns_to_analyze <- c("Total", "Baseline", "On-treatment", "Post-treatment")
all_stats <- map_dfr(columns_to_analyze, ~calculate_column_stats(chemo_immuno_result75, .x))

# Calculate cell type specific statistics
cell_type_stats <- chemo_immuno_result75 %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -ParentCell,
    names_to = "Phase",
    values_to = "Count"
  ) %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = sd(Count)/mean(Count),
    Min = min(Count),
    Max = max(Count),
    Range = max(Count) - min(Count),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Calculate phase-specific statistics
phase_stats <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(Column) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Cells = sum(Count),
    Mean_Count = mean(Count),
    SD = sd(Count),
    Variance = var(Count),
    CV = SD/Mean_Count,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 2)))

# Create detailed ratio analysis
ratio_analysis <- all_stats %>%
  select(ParentCell, Column, Ratio) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Column,
    values_from = Ratio,
    names_prefix = "Ratio_"
  )

# Create ratio variance analysis
ratio_variance <- all_stats %>%
  group_by(ParentCell) %>%
  summarise(
    Ratio_Mean = mean(Ratio),
    Ratio_SD = sd(Ratio),
    Ratio_Variance = var(Ratio),
    Ratio_CV = Ratio_SD/Ratio_Mean,
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)))
```

```{r}

print(ratio_analysis)
```
